student_learning_goal: I can tell time and pick the right measurement tool.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can tell time and pick the right measurement tool.
header.character_watermark: Roo and Cal in the top-right with measurement tools. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: For 2 shapes, find PERIMETER (cm) and AREA (cm²).
parts.visual_layout: Two shapes drawn on a cm grid with two answer lines under each shape.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone perimeter+area layout for measurement worksheet, B&W line art. 2 shapes on cm grid: rectangle (4x3) and L-shape (5+2 squares). Below: P=___ cm, A=___ cm² lines for each.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P1_PA at Part 1: keywords name the shapes on grid for perimeter and area.

parts.answer_key: Rectangle: P=14 cm, A=12 cm². L-shape: P depends on layout, A=7 cm².

parts.student_instructions: Compare 1 capacity pair and 1 mass pair.
parts.visual_layout: One container pair and one pan balance with answer lines for each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone capacity and mass layout for measurement worksheet, B&W line art. 1 container pair: pail (6 cups) vs bowl (3 cups). 1 pan balance: 1 apple vs 5 grapes. Each with answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P2_CM at Part 2: keywords name the capacity and pan balance comparisons.

parts.answer_key: Capacity: pail more. Mass: apple heavier.

parts.student_instructions: Read 4 clocks (mix of analog + digital). Write the time.
parts.visual_layout: Four clock images mixing analog and digital displays with an answer line under each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone clock-reading layout for measurement worksheet, B&W line art. 4 clocks: analog 9:00, digital 3:30, analog 12:15, digital 6:45. Each with answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P3_CLOCKS at Part 3: keywords name the clocks for telling time.

parts.student_instructions: Match each measurement job to the right tool: (a) distance from school to park; (b) area of your desk; (c) time to read a book; (d) mass of a backpack.
parts.visual_layout: A 4-row table with job descriptions on the left and tool options (ruler, grid, clock, scale) on the right.
parts.answer_key: (a) ruler/measuring tape; (b) grid/cm² counter; (c) clock; (d) scale.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw a clock for 7:20 — both analog and digital.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone. Summative artifact — score on rubric. Part 4 'Pick the Tool' added — verifies attribute-tool matching across all 4 attributes (length/area/time/mass).
